name: Tidefury Cove
summary: Tidefury Cove’s reefs and wrecks still make these waters perilous for sailors. Makrura roam the shallows, while solitary anglers seek the quiet shore.

sections.title: A Graveyard of Ships and Reefs
sections.body: At the far end of Dustwallow Bay, Tidefury Cove lies between Theramore Isle and the Wyrmbog. Jagged reefs and shifting shoals have wrecked many vessels over the years, leaving rotting hulls half-submerged along the tide line. Makrura crawl over the wreckage, and the cove remains a dangerous, isolated shore. Hardy scavengers and quiet hermits come here to escape Theramore’s busy docks.

sections.title: The Historic Foothold
sections.body: During the invasion of Durotar, Tidefury Cove became a battleground. Admiral Daelin Proudmoore’s Kul Tiran expedition fortified the coast with a fortress and guard towers to command the approaches to Theramore. Thrall united the young Horde to break that hold. Orcs, Darkspear trolls, and tauren joined Rexxar and the Stonemaul ogres in an assault on the shore. They dismantled the Kul Tiran beachhead, then pressed toward the island fortress.

faq.answer: Tidefury Cove lies on Dustwallow Marsh’s southeastern coast, south of Theramore Isle and beside the Wyrmbog coast at the southern end of Dustwallow Bay.

faq.q: Why are there shipwrecks in Tidefury Cove?
faq.answer: Shallow sandbars and hidden rocky reefs make Tidefury Cove treacherous to navigate. Ships that stray too close run aground, then waves and scavengers soon break their hulls apart.

faq.q: Who lives in Tidefury Cove today?
faq.answer: Aggressive makrura roam Tidefury Cove, and famed angler Nat Pagle keeps an encampment called Nat’s Landing on one of the outer islets.

faq.q: What battle took place here in the past?
faq.answer: During Admiral Daelin Proudmoore’s campaign against the new Horde, Kul Tiran forces built a fortified coastal stronghold at Tidefury Cove. Thrall’s Horde, joined by tauren and ogre allies, destroyed it to clear the way to Theramore Isle.

angles.text: For the Horde, this coast was the starting point of the counter-offensive that broke Grand Admiral Proudmoore’s naval aggression and secured the young nation’s survival.
As a cook, you can fish the rich shallows of Dustwallow near master angler Nat Pagle, where fishermen seek prized catches.
